rule_unstated.value: can not parse package.yaml: missing required fields

label: broken

unstated.what: Exact error message text surfaced on failure: 'can not parse package.yaml: missing required fields' — the instruction says to surface the underlying tool's message but never states this string; the fix must route the exact snappy error text to stderr.
unstated.quote: self.assertTrue('can not parse package.yaml: missing required fields' in output_stderr)

instruction_covers: Failure of assemble must exit non-zero and print the underlying build tool's error message instead of silently dropping it; 'Snapping' progress stays on stdout and snap filename absent on failure.
reason: The instruction only requires surfacing the underlying error generally; the hidden test pins the exact stderr message text, which is not stated or inferable, and also requires stderr to be empty on success.
